about: Published component data for the airplane-components tests (gh-1397). Only values a manufacturer or a paper publishes, in the catalogue's field names and units. A field that is not published is absent here and in the Components built from it; nothing is estimated, and no resistance is derived from Kv and Io. See README.md in this folder.

conventions.rm_ohm: the page does not say whether the resistance is phase-to-phase or per phase
conventions.max_power_w: 180 s rating, electrical power not stated

axi_4120_14.name: Model Motors AXI 4120/14 (the motor of the Avistar Elite)

conventions.rm_ohm: unit written as 'm' in the table, read as milliohm (a resistance of 41 ohm is not possible for this motor); phase-to-phase or per phase not stated
conventions.efficiency_pct: the table's 'Max. Efficiency' (peak), not an efficiency at the maximum power

axi_4120_14.notes: Distributor's table of the AXi 41xx series (Esprit Model); it does not say which generation (original or V2) it describes. The Avistar paper names 'Model Motors AXI 4120/14 Outrunner' without a generation. A V2 listing on aerobertics.be (not reachable on 2026-11-18, page returned 404) was reported by a search result as 660 RPM/V, 41 mohm, 1.9 A, which would differ in Io.

scorpion_sii_2215_1400kv.name: Scorpion SII-2215-1400KV

conventions.rm_ohm: the page does not say whether phase-to-phase or per phase

scorpion_sii_2215_1400kv.notes: The page publishes 'Max Continuous Power: 518 Watts', a continuous rating; the catalogue field max_power_w is a different rating and is not filled from it.

scorpion_a_3017_600kv.name: Scorpion A-3017-600kv
scorpion_a_3017_600kv.notes: Max continuous power 555 W is published and not used (different rating).

thunder_power_prolitex_4s_6000.name: Thunder Power ProLiteX 25c 4S 14.8 V 6 Ah (the flight pack of the Avistar Elite)
thunder_power_prolitex_4s_6000.page: Dantsker, Caccamo, Vahora, Mancuso, AIAA 2020-0780, Table 2, https://cs-people.bu.edu/rmancuso/files/papers/UAVDB_Avistar_AIAAScitech20.pdf

published_wording.capacity_mah: Thunder Power ProLiteX 25c 4S 14.8 V 6 Ah lithium polymer battery
published_wording.c_rate: 25c (the product label; a continuous rating is not stated)
published_wording.cell_voltage_v: 14.8 V for 4S: 14.8 V / 4 cells = 3.7 V (the nameplate pack voltage divided by the cell count; the paper gives no per-cell value)

thunder_power_prolitex_4s_6000.notes: Table 1 of the paper gives 'Batteries 1.39 lb (0.63 kg)' for all batteries of the aircraft (flight pack, receiver battery, instrumentation battery), so the pack's own mass is not published there and is left absent.

apc_13x8e.name: Landing Products APC 13x8E (the propeller of the Avistar Elite)

published_wording.diameter_in: APC 13x8E (APC names a propeller diameter x pitch in inches)

avistar_elite_drive_train.meaning: The drive train the Avistar Elite flew with (aero_kernel/reference/avistar_elite). Not complete for airplane-components: max_power_w and the pack mass are not published.

tmotor_at2814_with_the_avistar_pack.meaning: A combination of published parts, not an aircraft. Rm, Io and max power are published; efficiency_pct and the pack mass are not.
